title: Let devotion show up in conduct
summary: Let truth grow visible in the way the body moves through the day. Let this stay near the next choice: hold onto this: the truest religion is clean conduct sustained by Naam.
takeaway: Let conduct answer before performance does.
lifeApplication: Before posting, promising, or advising, pause at the mouth and hands together. Choose the action that can carry the sacred words you want to say.

source.shortMeaning: Real religion keeps Naam and clean conduct bound together in one life.
source.lifeApplication: Before speaking devotion, ask if the next action can bear it.
